mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate level compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating, indicated by unemployment rate exceeding 4.0%, signals potential inflationary pressure and central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising rapidly and the federal funds rate is not sufficiently high, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL is rising and FEDFUNDS is not rising sufficiently, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A deceleration in retail sales growth (RSAFS growth rate below 0.5% in the last month) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS growth rate < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is above 150000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.5%) signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive central bank action and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.5% during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
